hooks.prompt: Review the conversation and determine whether handoffs.md has already been updated for this session. Return decision 'block' with a reason instructing Claude to append a new entry to the TOP of handoffs.md (following the existing structure: date, summary of what changed, next session candidates in priority order, workflow note — being specific about file names, business slugs, and any open issues) ONLY IF handoffs.md has not yet been updated this session. Otherwise return decision 'approve'.
